Standard medical guidance advises  [Highlight start] avoiding alcohol while taking **metronidazole** and for **48 to 72 hours (2 to 3 days)** after your last dose [Highlight end].[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXixLU32J-qLTsNOISJrQceEetmiLhqY_10vQyc0mNhVv2yGSte3IVMaoje2NsBVsACQAdAAPFhERln2ugupqKx5dhSqYjwD0WGd06CT15Yp0P76laEIemLCJ-jJ8fLQzfOqCq_AmBVg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1_dW3PHu5U5MVMaiBWbFHwIhXrJUmb1dNyTq5I3I9GjbQ0lGReUnqUayv4D30B0C3fRDxvPrRDYjpjQR11rlr3Tlqbez2cSBV4JaRBAlfQfeYIrKy66cvmoJmySkCnkZ5XsaDXH8onpjRjS5euvBMYt_e1UZ_zLzi1GcVvUMWEQzSeHcPFFRPXXBt4Y4dw)

### Waiting Period & Guidelines

- **During treatment:** Avoid alcoholic drinks and products containing alcohol or propylene glycol (such as some cough syrups, mouthwashes, or liquid medications).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF13jbxwTY0EEq77NRgoSNRWXbbeq2rLh1pXRkSEcLmmznB3vKO33ZcX39Qj4eCU_qS3pRQHgOid3TPJ3yKX6eb7kWACXODxiUpnOsCjqYLnzUtO4v5jjOcvcQveer5F-yI6tK4TfgB4rwFkmK9WhrIAW-kEFLY-bcR2raAKoSM-EtrwybH7Zpx3VzyPdq3xfaxkAjS49IBmRvBLWcaEg_fmdYEbbr4xA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXixLU32J-qLTsNOISJrQceEetmiLhqY_10vQyc0mNhVv2yGSte3IVMaoje2NsBVsACQAdAAPFhERln2ugupqKx5dhSqYjwD0WGd06CT15Yp0P76laEIemLCJ-jJ8fLQzfOqCq_AmBVg)
- **After finishing:** Wait at least **48 hours** (and up to **72 hours** for extra caution) after your final dose so the medication clears your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXixLU32J-qLTsNOISJrQceEetmiLhqY_10vQyc0mNhVv2yGSte3IVMaoje2NsBVsACQAdAAPFhERln2ugupqKx5dhSqYjwD0WGd06CT15Yp0P76laEIemLCJ-jJ8fLQzfOqCq_AmBVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1_dW3PHu5U5MVMaiBWbFHwIhXrJUmb1dNyTq5I3I9GjbQ0lGReUnqUayv4D30B0C3fRDxvPrRDYjpjQR11rlr3Tlqbez2cSBV4JaRBAlfQfeYIrKy66cvmoJmySkCnkZ5XsaDXH8onpjRjS5euvBMYt_e1UZ_zLzi1GcVvUMWEQzSeHcPFFRPXXBt4Y4dw)
- **Different forms:** Warnings apply to oral tablets, liquids, and suppositories. Vaginal gel can sometimes cause alcohol-related side effects, while topical skin creams or gels carry a much lower risk due to minimal absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX2CU1-QAYz6Ji8JD5bLJFAxjen8IbveMtxoLNgBldBObXcmVWqbv8vKNJGbm6va_OJBwa1DLgJltZLYXK3wr1j9nQ-ToReBX7393j4Ty-fu4spyGJXHAJ_zXDUXL8EEMwMIoV2lX2Qhxvg_DmejPLEeg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT)
- **General recovery:** Even when alcohol does not trigger a severe reaction, it can worsen common side effects like nausea and stomach upset and slow down your recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1y6uGkB8wPZg1bu-q-6rBbHDM_5JRauhw-aifSLq9c0qqWcdmgf1FIrXbcaRK9Fz-bwICXpkwH8DuO9T5fBA2CM7hfDLlYMSJ57LgD1fF2eySlTcNT2md7fHi6wNynydacIK404wCdqbTF-DRawXcl16yaldPaIgI63XkQ6Ryoq0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEBxCJF13jbxwTY0EEq77NRgoSNRWXbbeq2rLh1pXRkSEcLmmznB3vKO33ZcX39Qj4eCU_qS3pRQHgOid3TPJ3yKX6eb7kWACXODxiUpnOsCjqYLnzUtO4v5jjOcvcQveer5F-yI6tK4TfgB4rwFkmK9WhrIAW-kEFLY-bcR2raAKoSM-EtrwybH7Zpx3VzyPdq3xfaxkAjS49IBmRvBLWcaEg_fmdYEbbr4xA)

#### Potential Side Effects & Symptoms
Combining metronidazole and alcohol has traditionally been linked to a "disulfiram-like" reaction, which may cause:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXWi6BkDWPBaZjCEFYQTvQPI2tCY4viTqlNdJmFXHQmzmlS7IBGTzy8HJenPYc9gKBlAV8ggWcM_FCuehuDFU3PITlDUyX9subOY3kwrUzIILSQbm01IPt9KU_Lkxuc2I)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1zpAkuR3X1H-oamPO4xMMEpm6fCBuMbpR6bJMtgIaD4KydEpp_mHgG92kgbVCv6VEt8-5dfXFk0QMLKVuOF6cB-hm6Q0J0mcbSSf6bU6j6Mz73i5gYFm3lYoLV2sSsRiOR37tTDn7-EVLxpUUngLjlIAdZ6zAHj0_xn3YwWKG3uXE0o12ywu7_s)

- Nausea and vomiting
- Stomach cramps or pain
- Flushing or hot flashes (redness of the face and neck)
- Headache
- Pounding or fast heartbeat (palpitations)
- Sweating, shortness of breath, or fainting in more severe cases[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF1zpAkuR3X1H-oamPO4xMMEpm6fCBuMbpR6bJMtgIaD4KydEpp_mHgG92kgbVCv6VEt8-5dfXFk0QMLKVuOF6cB-hm6Q0J0mcbSSf6bU6j6Mz73i5gYFm3lYoLV2sSsRiOR37tTDn7-EVLxpUUngLjlIAdZ6zAHj0_xn3YwWKG3uXE0o12ywu7_s)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXixLU32J-qLTsNOISJrQceEetmiLhqY_10vQyc0mNhVv2yGSte3IVMaoje2NsBVsACQAdAAPFhERln2ugupqKx5dhSqYjwD0WGd06CT15Yp0P76laEIemLCJ-jJ8fLQzfOqCq_AmBVg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT)

#### What the Evidence Shows & What to Do

- **Mixed clinical evidence:** While official drug labels and clinicians recommend strict avoidance out of caution, controlled studies and reviews have not consistently confirmed a classic disulfiram-like interaction in humans. Even so, following the waiting period remains the safest choice.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1y6uGkB8wPZg1bu-q-6rBbHDM_5JRauhw-aifSLq9c0qqWcdmgf1FIrXbcaRK9Fz-bwICXpkwH8DuO9T5fBA2CM7hfDLlYMSJ57LgD1fF2eySlTcNT2md7fHi6wNynydacIK404wCdqbTF-DRawXcl16yaldPaIgI63XkQ6Ryoq0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX2CU1-QAYz6Ji8JD5bLJFAxjen8IbveMtxoLNgBldBObXcmVWqbv8vKNJGbm6va_OJBwa1DLgJltZLYXK3wr1j9nQ-ToReBX7393j4Ty-fu4spyGJXHAJ_zXDUXL8EEMwMIoV2lX2Qhxvg_DmejPLEeg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXWi6BkDWPBaZjCEFYQTvQPI2tCY4viTqlNdJmFXHQmzmlS7IBGTzy8HJenPYc9gKBlAV8ggWcM_FCuehuDFU3PITlDUyX9subOY3kwrUzIILSQbm01IPt9KU_Lkxuc2I)
- **If you already drank:** Stop drinking alcohol and avoid more until you finish treatment and wait the recommended window. Monitor how you feel, and seek prompt medical care if you develop severe symptoms, trouble breathing, or heart issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1_dW3PHu5U5MVMaiBWbFHwIhXrJUmb1dNyTq5I3I9GjbQ0lGReUnqUayv4D30B0C3fRDxvPrRDYjpjQR11rlr3Tlqbez2cSBV4JaRBAlfQfeYIrKy66cvmoJmySkCnkZ5XsaDXH8onpjRjS5euvBMYt_e1UZ_zLzi1GcVvUMWEQzSeHcPFFRPXXBt4Y4dw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX2CU1-QAYz6Ji8JD5bLJFAxjen8IbveMtxoLNgBldBObXcmVWqbv8vKNJGbm6va_OJBwa1DLgJltZLYXK3wr1j9nQ-ToReBX7393j4Ty-fu4spyGJXHAJ_zXDUXL8EEMwMIoV2lX2Qhxvg_DmejPLEeg)

For additional details on side effects and general precautions, see [Common questions about metronidazole - NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT) or [Metronidazole and Alcohol: Can You Drink with Metronidazole? - GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1y6uGkB8wPZg1bu-q-6rBbHDM_5JRauhw-aifSLq9c0qqWcdmgf1FIrXbcaRK9Fz-bwICXpkwH8DuO9T5fBA2CM7hfDLlYMSJ57LgD1fF2eySlTcNT2md7fHi6wNynydacIK404wCdqbTF-DRawXcl16yaldPaIgI63XkQ6Ryoq0).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF1-cTxSM8mM6JCpCwr6xAhnl64Q7A2G7LYpChxi74bZLGYqP8I9SRf7XVmoAaBdld3XIa-7bb2BojEkPk1gMSM1NC3t1LjEZvsDdB8FLT9bv3gu45-EkG52fl7Hh8jz5uggrO1HlLSKMCbQLF_wA7M6lOX3FMjIu0hF3BrWHCfITYDV7h3AcT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1y6uGkB8wPZg1bu-q-6rBbHDM_5JRauhw-aifSLq9c0qqWcdmgf1FIrXbcaRK9Fz-bwICXpkwH8DuO9T5fBA2CM7hfDLlYMSJ57LgD1fF2eySlTcNT2md7fHi6wNynydacIK404wCdqbTF-DRawXcl16yaldPaIgI63XkQ6Ryoq0)If you'd like more tailored information, let me know:

items.title: What the Evidence Shows & What to Do
items.text: Mixed clinical evidence: While official drug labels and clinicians recommend strict avoidance out of caution, controlled studies and reviews have not consistently confirmed a classic disulfiram-like interaction in humans. Even so, following the waiting period remains the safest choice. If you already drank: Stop drinking alcohol and avoid more until you finish treatment and wait the recommended window. Monitor how you feel, and seek prompt medical care if you develop severe symptoms, trouble breathing, or heart issues.
